name: liveprices-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the livePrices feature (devOnly + pro-tier + default OFF). Its only UI surface is the 'Live SG retailer prices' checkbox toggle in the Shopping/Budget panel (BudgetPanel.tsx), gated on useFeature('livePrices'); flipping it on drives the useLivePrices hook against the local price-server sidecar (npm run price-server, http://localhost:5175). This rung covers ONLY the tractable, no-sidecar surface: the full flag/tier/devOnly gating matrix (asserted at BOTH the store-flag level AND the real UI-mount level) plus the reachable pre-network UI state. The gating story here is richer than a typical pro flag because livePrices' registry default is FALSE: (1) Simple mode -> false (pro-tier forced off) -> toggle absent; (2) switch to Pro -> STILL false, because the default is off, so switching mode alone is NOT enough to reveal it -> toggle STILL absent (the distinguishing case vs. every default-on pro flag); (3) an explicit dev/admin override (setFeatureFlag('livePrices', true)) -> true -> the toggle finally mounts, unchecked, with the estimate caption still showing (no fetch has run); (4) switch back to Simple -> false again, because the pro-tier gate wins over the LS override -> toggle gone. The toggle is deliberately never switched ON: flipping it fires pingPriceSidecar() -> fetch(http://localhost:5175/health), the feature's one and only sidecar contact, which is out of scope for a headless rung per the task's no-sidecar rule. That client (ping/fetch/cheapest-first/cache + the exact Simple/Pro/override gate matrix) is pinned by src/catalog/pricing/livePrice.test.ts, so the wire contract stays covered even though the live round-trip isn't driven here. The budget panel is left open across all four mode/flag flips so the toggle's appear/disappear tracks the resolved flag live.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: verify-simple-default
steps.failMessage: app should boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: livePrices is devOnly + pro-tier + default-off — expected false in Simple mode (registry.ts + resolve.ts)

steps.name: wait-budget-panel
steps.failMessage: Budget/Shopping panel did not mount after toggleBudget — it's a lazy chunk but idle-preloaded (preloadOnIdle.ts PRELOAD_ORDER), so it should be resident well before this timeout

steps.name: assert-toggle-absent-in-simple
steps.comment: The live-prices toggle is the only <input type=checkbox> in the budget panel (the other input is the numeric budget-target field), so its absence is a clean UI-mount gating proof.
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux input[type="checkbox"]')) throw new Error('Live SG retailer prices toggle rendered in Simple mode — livePrices is pro-tier and should be hidden'); if (document.body.textContent.includes('Live SG retailer prices')) throw new Error('live-prices label text present in Simple mode'); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-still-off-in-pro-default
steps.comment: The distinguishing case: unlike a default-on pro flag, livePrices' registry default is FALSE, so a privileged Pro session STILL resolves it off — switching to Pro alone does NOT reveal the toggle.
steps.failMessage: livePrices default is false — even a Pro (dev) session should stay off until an explicit override turns it on

steps.name: assert-toggle-still-absent-in-pro-default
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux input[type="checkbox"]')) throw new Error('Live SG retailer prices toggle rendered in Pro mode with no override — livePrices default is off, so switching to Pro must not reveal it'); })()

steps.name: enable-override
steps.comment: setFeatureFlag works in a dev build (IS_DEV) without an admin; it persists an LS override AND directly flips the store flag. livePrices is devOnly, but a dev/privileged session unlocks devOnly flags (resolve.ts).

steps.name: verify-flag-on-with-override
steps.failMessage: setFeatureFlag('livePrices', true) should turn the flag on in a dev session

steps.name: wait-toggle-mounts
steps.failMessage: The 'Live SG retailer prices' toggle should mount once livePrices resolves true (BudgetPanel.tsx gates it on useFeature('livePrices'))

steps.name: assert-toggle-present-unchecked-prenetwork
steps.comment: Reachable pre-network UI state: the toggle mounts UNCHECKED and enabled, and the caption still reads the estimate copy (liveOn=false, no useLivePrices fetch has run). It is deliberately not clicked — clicking fires pingPriceSidecar() -> fetch(localhost:5175), the feature's only sidecar contact, out of scope for a headless rung. The client + ping/fetch/cache + gate matrix are pinned by livePrice.test.ts.
steps.eval: (function(){ const cb = document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux input[type="checkbox"]'); if (!cb) throw new Error('live-prices toggle checkbox not found'); if (cb.checked) throw new Error('toggle should start UNCHECKED (liveOn=false, pre-network)'); if (cb.disabled) throw new Error('toggle should be enabled'); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Approx. mid-market retail')) throw new Error('caption should still read the estimate copy before the toggle is switched on (no live fetch has run)'); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-again-in-simple
steps.comment: The pro-tier gate wins over the persisted LS override — resolveFlags forces a pro flag off in Simple regardless of an override, so livePrices returns to false.
steps.failMessage: switching back to Simple should force livePrices off again even with the override in localStorage (tier gate beats override)

steps.name: assert-toggle-gone-again
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux input[type="checkbox"]')) throw new Error('toggle still present after switching back to Simple — the pro-tier gate should hide it again despite the LS override'); })()
